verdict.rationale: Manufact lets you connect an existing server by pasting its MCP URL with no deploy required, and can route it through the Manufact proxy as a managed connection. It works for Chat, testing, and the publish workflow. However, the docs frame this for servers "hosted elsewhere". The local CLI only covers running locally with hot reload and an inspector, so exposing a localhost server would need an external tunnel. Missing for 10: a first-party tunnel or bridge from a locally running server to a managed remote URL, documentation of local-to-remote connection flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
